description: Index of the bulk Polymarket L2 archive: one Parquet file per UTC day and stream (book_events, trades, l1_quotes), either multi-asset ('flat') or per asset and tenor ('family', e.g. btc + 5m). view='datasets' (default) lists files, filtered and paged, with `bytes` and `rows` where recorded; view='url' resolves exactly one file to a download link (give `date` and `stream`, plus `asset` and `tenor` together for a family file). This tool never downloads anything: the link is valid for 7 days (`expires_at`) and needs no API key, so fetch it yourself and do not share it. `asset` and `tenor` match family files ONLY, so supplying either hides every flat file. Returns {datasets, limit, offset, total} for 'datasets', one dataset row for 'url'.

asset.description: Family files only, e.g. `btc`. With view=url give it together with `tenor`, or neither.

date.description: view=url only. Required there. The UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD.

date_from.description: view=datasets only. First UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive (the REST route spells it `from`).

date_to.description: view=datasets only. Last UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive (the REST route spells it `to`).

limit.description: view=datasets only. Files per page (default 50, max 1000; `total` counts every match).

offset.description: view=datasets only. Skip this many matching files (default 0).

tenor.description: Family files only, e.g. `5m`. Pairs with `asset`.

view.description: datasets = list files (default); url = resolve one file.

name: polymarket_archive
title: Polymarket Archive
